theorems.name: Submission.one_le_density_on_support_of_locallyLp
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → ∀ x ∈ V.support, ∃ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t ∧ V.HasDensity x t
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
